$comment: Requests to the web_schedule_editor API and the answers they get. The format is the thermostat editor's (doc/TESTING.md), with an environment of its own and a case's `clock`.

cases.name: A name that is no route is 404
A GET to a route that writes is 405 naming POST
A POST to a route that reads is 405 naming GET
An OPTIONS is 405 too
Ping answers ok
Schema lists the limits, the days and the values each target takes
An empty device lists nothing, with its clock
List shows a running thermostat schedule, the point in force and the next
Before today's first point, yesterday's last is in force
Early on Monday, Sunday's last point is in force
Late on Sunday, the next point is Monday's first
On the minute of a point, that point is in force and the next is the one after
A week with one point has it in force all week, and next a week on
Without a valid clock a schedule waits and has no point in force
A disabled schedule says so and still shows its points
A relay the device does not have is a missing target, named by its id

schedules.0.status.reason: Relay "relay_7" is not on this device

cases.name: A thermostat the device does not have is a missing target

schedules.0.status.reason: Thermostat "attic" is not on this device

cases.name: A preset the thermostat does not have is a missing preset
A schedule on a stopped thermostat runs, and says the thermostat is stopped

schedules.0.status.note: Thermostat "Hall" is stopped; it starts in the scheduled values

cases.name: List is by id
Get answers the bare document, every day Monday first
Get of an unknown id is 404
Get without an id is 400
Get of an id that is no slug is 400
Targets lists the relays and the thermostats, and who schedules them
A disabled schedule drives nothing
Save without an id creates the schedule under an id made from its name
Save with an empty id creates too
Enabled is true when left out
A name whose id is taken gets the next free suffix
A name with no ASCII letter or digit gets the id schedule
The id new is reserved for the editor's blank form
The name is stored trimmed
Points are stored sorted, every day written, other keys dropped
Save with an existing id updates it, a rename keeps the id
Save of an unknown id is 404 and creates nothing
A thermostat the device does not have is stored with a warning
